title: Checking how new glasses fit
titleZh: 檢查新眼鏡的配戴狀況
passage:
F: My new glasses are fine when I read, but they slide down when I look inside my purse. Should I try a different frame?
M: Let’s keep this frame and adjust it first. Does the bridge feel loose even when you sit upright?
F: No, and it doesn’t pinch there either. It just moves when I lean forward.
M: Then I’ll adjust the arms behind your ears, not the nose pads. Afterward, please bend down again so we can check it here.
passageZh:
F: 戴新眼鏡看書沒問題，但低頭往手提包裡看，眼鏡就往下滑。我該換個鏡框嗎？
M: 我們先留著這副鏡框，調整看看。坐直時，鼻樑那裡也會覺得太鬆嗎？
F: 不會，也不會夾鼻樑；只有身體往前傾時才會滑動。
M: 那我會調整耳朵後方的鏡腳，不動鼻墊。調好後請再彎下身，我們當場確認。
